track.title: Math for Models
track.summary: Learn the small pieces of math that become embeddings, logits, probabilities, and training signals.

checkpoint.question: What does a vector represent in the simplest model-building sense?
checkpoint.answer: A vector is an ordered list of numbers used to represent features, embeddings, or activations.

checkpoint.question: Why do dot products appear in similarity and attention calculations?
checkpoint.answer: They add element-by-element aligned contributions between two vectors into one score.

checkpoint.question: What changes when logits pass through softmax?
checkpoint.answer: Raw scores become positive probabilities that sum to one.
